title: French Tour of South Manhattan
includes: Post-visit sheet with all our good addresses
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Accompanied by our French guides who have been living in New York for years, come and discover Lower Manhattan, the cradle of the city. Stroll the cobblestone streets of New York's oldest neighborhood, where every corner tells a story. Admire the historic architecture that blends harmoniously with the majestic modern skyscrapers, symbols of power and innovation. Let yourself be charmed by the unique atmosphere of this emblematic district, where past and present meet to offer an unforgettable experience.
